note: What `make load-demo-data` must produce once the audits have run. Written from the
checked-in demo websites under `app/demo/sites/`, and asserted by
`tests/integration/test_demo_audits.py`, so a change to a check, a threshold or a
finding shows up as a failure rather than as a quietly different answer.
Nothing here reaches the network: every host is either reserved (.invalid) or a demo
builder subdomain that exists only in this fixture, and all of them are answered

not_audited.demo-e8: closed_permanently — a business that has closed for good is not a lead

lonestarplumbing.invalid.case: A modern https site with a Calendly booking link, a Tawk.to chat widget and nothing missing.

bartoncreekplumbing.invalid.case: The old one: http only, no viewport, no description and a 2016 copyright.

zilkerpipeworks.invalid.case: WordPress, with no meta description and no structured data.

muellerplumbing.invalid.case: A Shopify store that also offers to schedule a visit.

hydeparkdrain.invalid.case: robots.txt disallows everything, so the homepage is never requested.

crestviewpipe.invalid.case: robots.txt answers 503. RFC 9309 says treat that as disallowed.

abcplumbing.invalid.case: The certificate does not verify, and is never retried without verification.

travisheightsplumbers.invalid.case: The listing gives http; the site redirects to https, which the audit follows.

badphoneplumbing.invalid.case: No fixture at all: a reserved host that cannot connect.

squaresitesewer.square.site.case: A JavaScript shell: a handful of scripts and almost no text in the HTML.

oakhillplumbing.invalid.case: No way to contact it, no heading, and a 2019 copyright.

wixwaterworks.wixsite.com.case: A Wix builder site that PageSpeed scores under the threshold.

godaddygutters.godaddysites.com.case: A GoDaddy builder site, the slowest in the set.

quickfixatx.invalid.case: PageSpeed is out of quota. The audit still finishes, with psi null.

messyformat-demo.com.case: The messy listing (no scheme, upper case, www.) still reaches its site.

temporarilyshut.invalid.case: Closed temporarily is still audited; only closed for good is skipped.

roofingcousins.invalid.case: A roofer: booking is expected in this trade too.

riversideplumbing.invalid.case: v0.5.0: the page text carries a prompt injection. The audit itself is ordinary.

copperlineelectric.invalid.case: The Copperhead shape, v0.11.0: an Elementor 'BOOK A SERVICE' button that links to the contact page and no booking tool. The call to action counts as booking, so there is no no_online_booking. A WordPress '--wp--preset--shadow--crisp' CSS token that is not the Crisp chat widget, and headings that skip from h2 to h5.

pecanstreetplumbing.invalid.case: Squarespace on its own domain (so no builder_subdomain), 4 of 5 images with no alt, a contact form labelled only by placeholders, 32 words of text and an h1 with nothing below it.

demo-e4.case: Only a Nextdoor page, so no site is fetched at all.

demo-e5.case: Only a Yelp page, so no site is fetched at all.

demo-e6.case: No website on the listing. The finding cites our own record.
